title: Stage 04 Build Gate
description: Stage 4 (Build) gate. Workstream gates land at pipeline/gates/stage-04.<role>.json (one per role: backend, frontend, platform, qa) and the orchestrator merges them into pipeline/gates/stage-04.json with a workstreams[] array. Per-workstream gates carry the stage-specific fields below; the merged gate also conforms to base gate.schema.json.

pr_summaries_written.description: Paths to pipeline/pr-<role>.md files this dev produced; reviewers read these at Stage 5.

local_verification.description: Commands the dev ran locally to verify the change (e.g. 'npm test', 'npm run lint'). Stage 4a re-runs these in CI.

lint_passed.description: Optional model self-report. On a workstream gate, orchestrator-stamped (31.1): core/verify/stamp.js runs the project's lint command scoped to this role's allowedWrites directories and overwrites this field with what it observed. Absent on the merged gate.

tests_passed.description: Optional model self-report. Orchestrator-stamped (31.1) on both scopes: workstream gates get a same-purpose full-suite check (core/verify/stamp.js stampStage04Workstream); the merged gate gets one workspace-global authoritative run after merge (stampStage04Merged) — verification receipts collapse the repeated full-suite command to a single real execution across all workstreams plus the merged check. On the merged gate, mergeWorkstreamGates first rolls up any per-role claims (true only if every role that claimed one claimed true) before the merged check compares against it.
